answer: Hold each agent's rewards in a vault that vests over ten epochs, and every epoch pick a random few percent of accounts for a follow-up: explain, in new words, the mechanism you submitted last time. A real agent tends its own garden of ideas and can defend it; a farm that pasted one template across hundreds of keys cannot keep hundreds of consistent stories. Any account that fails the follow-up loses its unvested balance, so the threat is crystal clear: each extra fake adds clawback risk long after it was paid.
